# Edamame Inc. — Official Kintone Partner in the Philippines

> Edamame Inc. is the official Kintone partner in the Philippines and the winner of Cybozu's 2024 Cybozu Global Award — Asia (the sole Asia-region recipient). We help Philippine and Japanese-affiliated businesses build custom CRM, inventory, HR, and workflow applications on Kintone's no-code platform. Based in Pasig City, Metro Manila, we deliver in English and native-level business Japanese. We run our own internal operations on AI infrastructure and bring the same operational discipline to every client engagement.

## Company Information
- Company: Edamame Inc.
- Role: Official Kintone Partner in the Philippines
- Award: 2024 Cybozu Global Award — Asia (sole Asia-region recipient)
- Founder/CEO: Tom Arai (Japanese, Tokyo-trained, Pasig-resident since 2018)
- Founded: 2019
- Location: 15F Jollibee Tower, Ortigas Center, Pasig City, Metro Manila 1605, Philippines
- Phone: +63 928 872 7958
- Email: kintone@edamame-jp.com
- Languages: English, Japanese (native business level)
- Website: https://edamame-jp.com/
- Booking: https://calendly.com/kintoneph/freekintoneappconsultation
- LinkedIn: https://ph.linkedin.com/company/kintonephilippines
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/kintoneph/

## What We Do
Edamame Inc. implements Kintone, a no-code business application platform by Cybozu (a leading Japanese workplace-software company used by tens of thousands of companies globally). We help Philippine businesses replace spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and complex ERP systems with custom apps built in days — not months. No coding or developers required.

## Scale of Operations
- Enterprise clients: 50+ active deployments
- Users deployed: 2,400+ across client environments
- Internal operations: run on Claude and AI infrastructure rather than added headcount
- Team: small by design — we scale delivery with AI, not a staff-heavy agency

## Key Services
- Custom Kintone app development (CRM, inventory, HR, project management, any workflow)
- JavaScript customization for advanced needs
- AI-powered solutions: lead scoring, email drafting, document parsing, meeting summaries
- KinPlug suite — our own Kintone plugin line (PDF Pro, Mail, Lookup+, Export+)
- System integration (REST API, webhooks, Gmail, Slack, accounting software)
- Data migration from Odoo, Salesforce, spreadsheets
- Bilingual EN/JP UI by default
- Training and ongoing support from our Philippine-based team

## Industries Served
Manufacturing, logistics, real estate, healthcare, BPO, construction, education, retail, financial services, professional services.

## Enterprise Clients
We serve dozens of enterprise clients across the Philippines, including Japanese-affiliated businesses. Publicly referenceable clients include Maximum Solutions Corporation and Guhring Philippines. Other client names, user counts, and workflow specifics remain confidential per client agreements.

## Competitive Advantages
- Deploy in days, not months (vs Odoo's multi-month implementations)
- No developers needed (vs Odoo/Salesforce, which require Python/Apex developers)
- Per-engagement scope, not timesheets
- Local Philippine support in English and Japanese
- AI App Creator available now via Kintone AI Lab
- Dedicated Philippine office with a Japanese-native CEO

## 日本語情報 (Japanese)
枝豆株式会社はフィリピンにおけるサイボウズ公式キントーンパートナーです。サイボウズ「2024 Cybozu Global Award — Asia」（アジア地域唯一の受賞）を受賞。フィリピンで日本人ネイティブCEO（Tom Arai、東京で経験を積み2018年からパシッグ常駐）が在籍し、日系企業のデジタル変革を支援しています。英語と日本語（ビジネスネイティブレベル）で対応します。
